## From Idea to Index: How Twilio Voice and AI Helped Bring the Guinness Price Index to Life


## **Watch now to discover how to:**


- Industry deep dive from an expert partner: Gain strategic insights into the European market, exploring top CDP trends and real-world use cases across retail, telecom, and e-commerce.
- Customer spotlight: Hear first-hand how companies OrderYoYo leverage CDPs to maximise their data and improve ROI.
- Maximise your existing tech stack: Discover how a hybrid CDP architecture works alongside your current marketing solutions to enhance channel personalisation rather than replacing them.
- Transition to hyper-relevant marketing: Learn strategies to move away from generic transactional campaigns toward real-time alerts and tailored messaging triggered directly by customer browsing behaviour.


## Speakers


- Andrew Byrne, Senior Customer Success Manager, Twilio
- Phoebe Rose Aust, Marketing Automation Manager, OrderYoYo
- Lawrence Humblet, Director of Marketing Operations, McGaw
